info.title: v2.ams.get_targeted_campaign_addable_product_list
info.description: Returns a list of products that can be added to a targeted campaign

get.description: Returns a list of products that can be added to a targeted campaign

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is "" or not passed. If data is more than one page, the cursor can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Use the "page_size" filters to control the maximum number of entries to retrieve per page (i.e., per call). This integer value is used to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single "page" of data. The limit of page_size if between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: search_content
parameters.description: Search by item name or item ID, item_id should be split by comma and at most 50 items. Please specify search_type for it to be effective, otherwise search_content will be ignored.

parameters.name: search_type
parameters.description: Search type: ITEM_NAME or ITEM_ID, used with search_content.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Use this field to specify which field to use to sort the returned item list. Available values: -sales: Sort by sales in descending order (default value) sales: Sort by sales in ascending order -stock: Sort by inventory in descending order stock: Sort by inventory in ascending order -price: Sort by price in descending order price: Sort by price in ascending order

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ams/get_targeted_campaign_addable_product_list?access_token=access_token&cursor=abcd&page_size=20&partner_id=partner_id&search_content=101%2C102&search_type=ITEM_ID&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&sort_by=-sales&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
